title: First average velocity
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the average velocity at the first gate using v1 = L / Δt1, yielding 0.10 m/s.

title: Second average velocity
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the average velocity at the second gate using v2 = L / Δt2, yielding 0.20 m/s.

title: Acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the acceleration using a = (v2 - v1) / Δt, yielding 0.025 m/s².

title: Distance between gates
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the distance using a kinematic equation (e.g., x = (v2² - v1²) / (2a)), yielding 0.60 m.

title: Unit conversion
description: Important: Converts the plate width from cm to m (0.020 m) before performing velocity calculations.

title: Physics principle application
description: Important: Recognizes that the average velocity through each gate equals the plate width divided by the blocking time.

title: Acceleration derivation
description: Important: Applies the definition of average acceleration (Δv/Δt) using the velocities and the given time interval.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in acceleration (e.g., v1 - v2) or omits/fails to convert units, leading to incorrect magnitude.

title: Incorrect distance formula
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect kinematic formula for distance (e.g., using average velocity without acceleration) instead of one consistent with uniform acceleration.
